note: A mown grass field, about 150 m by 110 m on imagery, at the end of Fire Tower Road and booked as a single site: open, with almost no shade, and well away from traffic. A gate at the entrance has to be opened and closed behind each vehicle. The whole field is grass with no hardened pad, so pick ground with care after rain. Gravel all the way in: about 0.3 mile of Bark Road from US 30 on top of Sideling Hill, then 0.3 mile of Fire Tower Road. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
